public.text: The business-services layer contains shared components such as the Computable Decision Support Engine, HMIS, and Public Health Surveillance Platform. Some of these may execute operational or transactional functions, which appears to conflict with the later criterion that DPI-H components should be non-transactional.
public.suggestedRevision: Refine the component criterion from “non-transactional” to a more precise distinction, such as: “not primarily responsible for local point-of-service workflow or programme-specific transaction processing.” Then assess each business-service component against the revised criterion.
